mobbin:d7a0fc7c-713c-40b5-bbc4-4447ba7e6.summary: User starts a new conversation from Home, records with live transcript and in-session markers, browses Summary/Chat/Comments tabs, then returns to Home where the finished note shows an AI summary snippet and attached image.
steps: New note: empty transcript + record bar
Live record: type note + highlight tool on
Home card: AI summary + captured image
Home feed: reactions and comment counts
steal: Recording bar: one-tap highlight / comment / image while live (steps Live record, Session titled)
Chat empty state states 'Chat is visible to all conversation participants' (Otter Chat empty)
Summary tab shows 'Creating a live summary...' placeholders during capture (Summary tab)
Home card surfaces AI bullet + attached visual before opening the note (Home card)
avoid: AI summary and Share appear with no faculty approve/edit gate before others can see them — clashes with Baseline human-review-before-share for ai-debrief
mobbin:d7a0fc7c-713c-40b5-bbc4-4447ba7e6.fit: Maps to phone-as-debrief-capture + private annotation second screen; extends SRV Transcript/Annotation with live markers and AI chat, but needs an approve step before learner-visible summary.

mobbin:c2a5d587-f496-4eb4-bc78-509bd3c32.summary: After a recording saves to Home, the user opens the conversation Summary (narrative, action items, outline), uses More for rematch/sync tools, then reviews the speaker-labelled Transcript with keyword tags, talk-time breakdown, and timestamped Outline jumps.
steps: Home: recording saved toast + recent list
Summary: narrative + action items + chat prompts
More menu: Rematch speakers / Sync text
steal: Suggested chat prompts on empty Chat ('was I mentioned?', action items, decisions) (Summary step)
More menu: Rematch speakers + Sync text to audio for fixing attribution (More menu)
Outline items deep-link with timestamps; thumbs Useful/Not Useful under summary (Transcript step)
Speakers panel with color + talk-time % next to searchable transcript (Transcript step)
avoid: Don't build this: AI Summary is shown with Copy Summary, Share, and Post to Slack as primary actions and no edit/approve gate before distribution
mobbin:c2a5d587-f496-4eb4-bc78-509bd3c32.fit: Counter-example for Baseline ai-debrief: auto-surfaces AI summary ready to distribute without faculty review; still steal outline timestamps and Rematch speakers into an approve-first SRV phone view.
